look_here_first: Look for narrow foxtail-like cylindrical grass inflorescences and bristles subtending the spikelets; confirm the basal knotty rhizomes and details of spikelet glumes to separate weedy foxtails.
photo_note: One permanent, attributed photo installed for initial visual recognition. Additional anatomy/identity review is necessary; this batch does not determine regional nativity.
identification_caution: Source identifies species sensu Manual of Grasses for North America from a Croatian photo; not locality evidence for Texas.
